geothermal.notes: Regenerated directly from Stanford Thermal Model CSV with nearest-hexagon assignment (no vertical banding). Hexagons built in EPSG:5070 equal-area projection so they tile perfectly (no overlaps/gaps) and every cell has an identical exact area (~64.95 sq mi, 5-mile circumradius), stored as area_sq_miles/area_km2 for valid area calculations. Empty (ocean/off-domain) cells omitted.
